verdict.rationale: Turso's marketing claims "Data residency you control" and bring-your-own-cloud deployment. The durability docs say Pro and Enterprise customers can use their own S3 buckets so data lives inside their own infrastructure. That is a real, first-party residency capability, but it is limited to paid tiers, and the pack has no documented region-selection mechanism. Missing for 10: documented region/location choice at database creation (CLI flag or API parameter), a list of available regions, residency control on lower tiers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Bring-your-own-cloud deployment. Data residency you control.
Pro and Enterprise customers can use their own S3 / S3-express buckets, guaranteeing that data lives inside their infrastructure.
